creator_type: parent creator (mom, baby about 5 to 6 months) with a guest professional (SLP, tagged @hilla_gover_slp)
product: A colourful board book (yellow spine, train-of-animals/people picture on the open pages). No brand or title legible on screen or in caption.
disclosure_visible: none visible (caption thanks the SLP: 'תודה להלה שלי קלינאית התקשורת'; paid_partnership_label=0)
format: staged coaching scene: speech-language therapist shows a mom how to read a book to her baby, with burned-in subtitles

hook_0_3s.opening_image: Two women sit on a floor sofa against a white wall; the one on the left holds a baby on her lap with an open yellow board book, the other (right) laughs and watches.
hook_0_3s.spoken: 0.0-5.7 s machine transcript: 'טוב, דריה כבר כמעט בת חצי שנה, והאמת שעד עכשיו לא כזה הקפדתי להקריא לסיפורים.'
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: Subtitle appears from about 1 s: 'דריה כבר כמעט' then 'בת חצי שנה והאמת' then 'שעד עכשיו לא כזה' (no separate headline).
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: an honest admission ('I haven't been reading to her much') plus a visible expert about to correct it creates a mini story of 'what is she going to be told'.

how_value_is_shown: The value is the reading technique, not the product: each tip is spoken and a subtitle repeats it while the women act it out with the baby and the board book.
demonstration: Positioning the baby to see mom and book, reading with an exaggerated face, pointing at the page, letting the baby touch the book.
proof: none (no result or before/after; the baby's reactions are shown, interpretation: only a mild signal)
emotion: Warm, playful, light humour (laughing, exaggerated surprised face at 16 to 17 s, delighted face at 48 to 50 s).
personal_story: Mom says her baby is almost half a year old and she had not been careful about reading aloud until now; she is helped by a friend who is an SLP.
selling_language: No selling language. Machine transcript: 'ספר טוב הוא הרבה יותר מסיפור'
captions_on_screen: burned-in subtitles of speech, white bold Hebrew, one short phrase at a time in the lower middle of the frame; one small pink smiley sticker at about 17 s
editing_rhythm: About 8 shots in 52 s (average about 6.5 s per shot), cuts between a wide and a close angle, no speed changes seen, fade to dark in the last second.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: wide shot of both women and baby with the book, fade out; subtitle 'וזה בדיוק מה שדריה' at 48 s. No CTA in the video. Caption thanks the SLP and says she is available for questions, with her tag and hashtags.
convincing: Interpretation: a real mom admitting a gap and a credentialed friend giving short, specific, visible tips; the tips are acted out on the actual baby so the viewer sees each one.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the speech is a voiceover that does not always match the visible mouths, the book is unnamed so the video does not work as a product pitch, and 52 s with no CTA.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a 'how to read a book with your child' tip format with an expert friend fits a personalised book well; recreate with a phone propped on a sofa: wide shot, then close-ups of a hand pointing at a page, subtitles one short phrase at a time, one honest personal line in the first 3 s.
solo_without_child: partly: the tips can be shown with a book and hands only, but this Reel relies on a baby and a second adult being on camera
not_verified: Whose voice is speaking in each line (mom or SLP) and whether the speech was recorded live or added later; the title and brand of the board book; the baby age is from the transcript only; audio music.
